answer_1.quote: We evaluate various baselines on GRANOLA-EQ, including greedy decoding and methods that abstain from answering in cases of uncertainty ... DRAG uses temperature sampling to obtain a set of candidate responses, and then answers the original question based on an aggregation of these responses.
answer_1.outputs: Generated factual answers to open-domain questions

answer_2.quote: GRANOLA accuracy is defined as 1[i =⊥]. Informativeness is defined as exp(-λ • (i -1)) ... we also report standard accuracy, exact‑match and token‑F1 scores.

answer_4.quote: We manually evaluate the quality of a generated answer a with respect to a question q from GRANOLA-EQ across the following axes: Correctness, Informativeness, Granularity ... We manually evaluate a sample of 1% of the data (124 questions and their corresponding 358 answers).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assess each generated answer for correctness, informativeness, and granularity.
